firearm.title: Free Firearm Sound Library — prepared recordings
firearm.creator: Ben Jaszczak; Brian Nelson; Kevin Heras; Matthew Nanney

equipment.title: equipment clicks III

equipment.attribution: equipment clicks III — LFA; https://opengameart.org/content/equipment-clicks-iii; CC0-1.0. Project ONE edits are listed per generated cue in recipes.json and manifest.json.
